name: prompt-to-products
title: Prompt To Products
description: A request is typed into a chat bar and sent; three product cards answer, the chosen price gets a marker highlight and a check, and the total counts up. Ends on the products and a price.
useWhen: Selling through chat: a customer asks for something and the shop answers with options and a price.
A small shop or service wants a typed-request-to-offer beat in its own colours.
avoidWhen: You want the chat input alone, with suggestion chips and no answer: use ai-prompt-composer.
The answer should be a long reply or a conversation: use a chat-flow block.
author: Mosio
